what: Pins the section for 800% of the screen height (no extra spacing — whichever side uses the section height supplies it) and over the first 600% of scroll covers the layers one by one from below — each layer goes clip-path inset(100% 0 0 0)→0 in 1 unit of power2.inOut, and at the same time the new image also opens from below while the previous image lifts away upward with inset(0 0 100% 0). If there are more layers than images, it fires fx:frame (progress 0→1, straight line) during the remaining layers to step through the last image (a frame sequence). Under 767px width: pin 600%, cover 400%

options.pin: Fixed length (% of screen height), default 800
options.run: Scroll position where covering ends (% of screen height), default 600

use:
Layer 1
Layer 2
note: The original sets the section height to 800vh and pins 800% with no offset — even after the section ends, the last layer stays attached for one more screen, and the next section (higher z-index) rises covering it. Where the next section does not cover it, set the section height to the pinned length + 100vh

from.where: index.html [data-slot=layer-reveal] — a section that covers layer by layer: blueprint → glass bezel → dial → movement
